name: proxySet
description: Write the profile's proxy configuration. It takes effect for the next request, with no restart; a request already under way keeps its route. Resolves what proxyGet resolves. Errors: PROXY_INVALID with error.data = { field, reason } (reason `malformed`, `scheme`, `credentials`, `tooLong`, `required`), PROXY_OVERRIDDEN when a command-line switch, an extension or a policy holds the value. Additive action, manifest primitive network.proxy.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: `system` (follow the operating system; removes the stored value), `direct` (no proxy), `fixed` (one proxy server, see `server`), `pac` (see `pacUrl`) or `autoDetect` (discover a PAC script on the network).

inputs.name: server
inputs.description: With `fixed`: the proxy as scheme://host[:port], scheme `http`, `https`, `socks4` or `socks5`. A username or password in it is refused (reason `credentials`): they go in `username` and `password`.

inputs.name: username
inputs.description: With `fixed` and an `http` or `https` server: the user name the proxy asks for, at most 255 characters, no `:`. Absent or empty removes the stored sign-in. Refused with a `socks4` or `socks5` server (field `username`, reason `scheme`).

inputs.name: password
inputs.description: With `username`: the password, at most 255 characters. It is stored sealed and never returned. Absent or empty keeps the stored password when the server and the user name are the ones it was stored for, and is refused otherwise (field `password`, reason `required`).

inputs.name: bypassList
inputs.description: With `fixed`: hosts that are reached without the proxy, separated by `;` or `,`, in the proxy bypass rule syntax (`*.example.com`, `10.0.0.0/8`, `<local>`). At most 4096 characters.

inputs.name: pacUrl
inputs.description: With `pac`: the http or https URL of the proxy auto-config script.
